stem_book: What is true for work done in clockwise cyclic process on a P–V diagram? (Take w as work done on the system, IUPAC sign convention.) (a) Work is positive (b) Work is zero (c) Work is done on the system (d) Work is negative
reason: Sign-convention assumption (IUPAC, as in the lecture theory) added so the answer is unique.
work: Clockwise loop: net work done BY the system = enclosed area > 0 ⇒ w (on system) = −area < 0
